description: Re-encodes JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and JPEG XL images with the Squoosh codecs (MozJPEG, OxiPNG, libwebp, libavif, libjxl): convert between formats, compress at a quality, and shrink to a maximum width/height or a percentage (Lanczos3, aspect kept, never enlarged). Metadata is not carried over.

background.description: Fill for transparent pixels when writing JPEG (default #ffffff)

name: image_convert
title: Convert, compress and resize images
